items.title: Derrick Jones Jr. on Isaiah Jackson starting: “Honestly, I think he’s one of the fastest big men in the league. He’s up there with me. So, honestly, you have him running one side, me running on the other side, I love our chances. He brings a lot to the table.”
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: Derrick Jones Jr. on Isaiah Jackson starting: “Honestly, I think he’s one of the fastest big men in the league. He’s up there with me. So, honestly, you have him running one side, me running on the other side, I love our chances. He brings a lot to the table.”

items.title: Tyronn Lue on Isaiah Jackson’s defense: “We’re going to mix it up. We’re definitely going to do some different things. Not a steady diet of the same thing every single time, but he has the ability, like you said, to get out and switch 1 through 5.”
items.author: Justin Russo

items.title: Tyronn Lue on Isaiah Jackson as the starting center: “I think he’ll be good for us. I think being able to outrun most centers, just in transition, so now centers are cross-matched. That’s what we’ve gotta continue to keep preaching to Isaiah, just using your speed and quickness.”
